channel.title: ALTRENDAT
channel.description: What the world is searching for, explained with sources

item.title: Game Informer releases 14-page GTA 6 cover story with 12 exclusive screenshots
item.description: Game Informer published a 14-page cover story on Grand Theft Auto VI featuring developer interviews with Rockstar Games and 12 exclusive new screenshots of the game's Vice City setting.

item.title: Six Flags closes X2 roller coaster permanently after years of reported injuries
item.description: Six Flags Magic Mountain permanently closed the X2 roller coaster on Tuesday following a history of injuries and deaths, including lawsuits from riders who suffered brain injuries.

item.title: Spain hosts Croatia in Nations League with 39-game winning streak on the line
item.description: World champions Spain face Croatia on Tuesday in Seville in a UEFA Nations League Group A3 match, with Spain seeking to extend their record 39-game European winning streak.

item.title: Luzardo starts Game 1 for Phillies against Braves after three weeks off
item.description: Jesús Luzardo will open the wild-card series for Philadelphia against Atlanta on Tuesday afternoon, his first appearance since September 7 due to left shoulder inflammation.

item.title: Phillies travel to Atlanta for Wild Card rematch against Braves on Tuesday
item.description: The Phillies face the Braves in a best-of-three Wild Card Series at Truist Park in Atlanta starting Tuesday at 2 p.m. ET, with Chris Sale pitching for Atlanta.

item.title: FBI seizes $15 billion in Operation Blackout targeting global scam compounds
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel announced that Operation Blackout has seized more than $15 billion in assets and cryptocurrency while dismantling international fraud networks that targeted senior citizens across multiple countries.

item.title: Giants release Odell Beckham Jr. after playing just 19 snaps over three games
item.description: The New York Giants released wide receiver Odell Beckham Jr. on Tuesday after he played only 19 snaps across three games and failed to catch a pass.

item.title: Tom Cruise transforms into oil baron in Alejandro González Iñárritu's 'weirdest' satirical comedy
item.description: Tom Cruise plays Digger Rockwell, a bizarre Texan oil tycoon in director Alejandro González Iñárritu's divisive eco-satire that marks the biggest creative risk of Cruise's career.

item.title: Social Security COLA for 2027 forecast at 3.5%, largest increase in four years
item.description: The Social Security Administration will announce the 2027 cost-of-living adjustment on October 14, with forecasts predicting a 3.5% increase—the largest in four years—that would raise average monthly benefits by about $67.90.

item.title: Finland hosts Belarus in UEFA Nations League seeking to build on 7-0 opening win
item.description: Finland, ranked top of Group 1 after defeating San Marino 7-0 in their opener, faces Belarus at Helsinki's Olympiastadion in UEFA Nations League C, with Belarus looking to recover from a 2-0 loss to Albania.

item.title: Camryn Manheim jokes she wanted gay son at Human Rights Campaign gala
item.description: Actress Camryn Manheim said at the Human Rights Campaign's National Dinner on Sunday that she "always wanted a gay son," but her son turned out to be heterosexual.

item.title: Egypt rests Salah for South Sudan qualifier due to artificial pitch
item.description: Egypt's Mohamed Salah will not play in the AFCON qualification match against South Sudan on September 29 because coach Hossam Hassan decided to rest him due to the stadium's artificial surface.

item.title: Nigeria battles Guinea-Bissau in 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifier
item.description: Nigeria played Guinea-Bissau in an Africa Cup of Nations qualification match as the Super Eagles continued their 2027 tournament campaign following their win over Madagascar.

item.title: Ghana faces Gambia in Africa Cup of Nations qualifier with fans urged to show belief
item.description: Ghana's Sports Fund Administrator calls on supporters to trust the Black Stars ahead of their Africa Cup of Nations qualification match against Gambia today.

item.title: Oracle books $30 billion in AI cloud contracts, lifts revenue pipeline to record $664 billion
item.description: Oracle added more than $30 billion in AI cloud contracts in its fiscal first quarter, pushing remaining performance obligations to a record $664 billion, up $209 billion year over year, with management expecting about half to convert to sales over the next 36 months.

item.title: Liberty stuns top-seeded Lynx 91-75 in first WNBA playoff game
item.description: The New York Liberty defeated the No. 1 seed Minnesota Lynx 91-75 on Sunday in Game 1 of their first-round series, with forward Breanna Stewart scoring 34 points.

item.title: Judge ruled out for Wild Card Series against Red Sox with calf strain
item.description: Yankees slugger Aaron Judge will miss the entire Wild Card Series against Boston after being sidelined since September 16 with a calf injury, though designated hitter Giancarlo Stanton is available.

item.title: MLB Wild Card Series kicks off with four games on Tuesday
item.description: The MLB playoffs begin Tuesday, September 29, with all four Wild Card Series matchups getting underway, including Phillies vs. Braves at 2:00 PM ET, White Sox vs. Astros at 5:00 PM ET, Red Sox vs. Yankees at 8:00 PM ET, and Cubs vs. Padres at 10:00 PM ET.

item.title: Madagascar and Tanzania seek first points in AFCON 2027 qualifying after opening defeats
item.description: Madagascar and Tanzania face each other on Tuesday, September 29, in Group L of the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers, both searching for their first points after losing their opening matches.

item.title: Senegal chases first win under Vieira against Ethiopia in AFCON qualifier
item.description: Senegal faces Ethiopia on Tuesday in Bahir Dar in the second matchday of the 2027 AFCON qualifiers, seeking Patrick Vieira's first victory after drawing 1-1 with Mozambique.

item.title: Morocco faces Lesotho in AFCON qualifier at South African stadium
item.description: Morocco plays Lesotho on Tuesday at Free State Toyota Stadium in Bloemfontein, South Africa, in their second Africa Cup of Nations 2027 qualifying match, with captain Achraf Hakimi returning after suspension.

item.title: Zoe Saldaña says 'Lioness' role leaves no room for another Taylor Sheridan project
item.description: Oscar-winning actress Zoe Saldaña told People that her demanding lead role in Taylor Sheridan's CIA drama 'Lioness' is all she can handle, with Season 3 having ended on Paramount+ in September.

item.title: Matt Rife credits TikTok viral clips for career breakthrough after Hollywood rejection
item.description: Comedian Matt Rife says his 20.3 million TikTok followers and reported $40-50 million net worth came from viral crowd work clips on the platform, after years struggling in Los Angeles's traditional comedy circuit earned him only $40-60 thousand annually.

item.title: Warwick Davis Returns as Professor Flitwick for HBO's Harry Potter Series
item.description: Original Harry Potter film actor Warwick Davis will reprise his role as Professor Flitwick in HBO's new Harry Potter television adaptation, calling it "a huge honour" ahead of the series premiere.

item.title: Royal family questions Harry and Meghan's motives after U.K. return, palace issues clarification
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have been back in the U.K. for a month, but senior royal family members still don't know their agenda, prompting King Charles to issue a letter clarifying the couple's status as non-working royals.

item.title: Henry Winkler's 'Chanukah Song' shoutout from Adam Sandler led to Waterboy role
item.description: Actor Henry Winkler said a 1994 Saturday Night Live shoutout from Adam Sandler mentioning his Happy Days character led to him calling Sandler, which eventually resulted in Winkler being cast as Coach Klein in the 1998 comedy film The Waterboy without an audition.

item.title: Raiders reach 3-0 after Saints comeback; Bengals, Chiefs climb in Week 3 rankings
item.description: The Las Vegas Raiders improved to 3-0 with a 35-27 win over the Saints, while the Cincinnati Bengals and Kansas City Chiefs climbed the NFL power rankings after Week 2, and the Tampa Bay Buccaneers plummeted following a home loss.

item.title: Adam Scott's Presidents Cup drought extends as Internationals lose again
item.description: Adam Scott and the International Team lost the Presidents Cup for the 22nd consecutive time since his debut in 2003, with Team USA completing a comeback victory in Sunday singles.

item.title: Trump administration cuts fuel efficiency requirements for US carmakers through 2031
item.description: The Trump administration finalized new fuel economy rules Monday that reduce annual efficiency increases from 2% to 1%, lowering the 2031 target to 34.9 miles per gallon from the previous 50.4 mpg goal.

item.title: ESPN Unlimited now fully integrated into YouTube TV at no extra cost
item.description: YouTube TV subscribers with ESPN access can now watch ESPN Unlimited's thousands of live sports events at no additional charge, though some programs remain restricted by rights agreements.

item.title: Lola Vice wins Money in the Bank qualifier in Raw main roster debut
item.description: Lola Vice, promoted from NXT after four and a half years, won her first WWE main roster match and qualified for the Women's Money in the Bank ladder match.

item.title: Trump's Greece Ambassador Guilfoyle Disputed Over U.S. Influence Remarks at Athens Dinner
item.description: Kimberly Guilfoyle, U.S. Ambassador to Greece, faced scrutiny over alleged comments at a March dinner in Athens suggesting the U.S. could influence Greece's government, claims she and Greek officials have denied.

item.title: Trump approval rating hits career low amid voter economic concerns
item.description: A CNN poll shows Trump's overall approval rating fell to 33%, with just 27% approving of his economic handling as two-thirds of voters say the economy is extremely important to their midterm vote.

item.title: Texas Clinic Owner Convicted of $26M Military Health Fraud Scheme
item.description: A Texas clinic owner has been convicted of orchestrating a massive $26 million TRICARE fraud scheme, using stolen military healthcare dollars to purchase a gold-plated Cybertruck and fund extravagant parties.

item.title: Stock Market Tumbles As Oil Surges And Bond Yields Hit Fresh Peaks
item.description: U.S. stocks fell sharply Monday as climbing oil prices and soaring Treasury yields ignited fresh rate-hike concerns ahead of next week's critical Fed decision.

item.title: Microsoft's AI Breakthrough Unlocks Years of Growth as Azure Crosses Major Milestone
item.description: Microsoft's Azure cloud platform has achieved a critical AI infrastructure milestone that Wall Street analysts thought was years away, triggering a major rating upgrade as Copilot adoption accelerates.

item.title: QQQ Stock Faces Critical Juncture As Midterm Elections Reshape Market Dynamics
item.description: Historical patterns suggest tech-heavy QQQ could deliver outsized gains post-midterms, but political uncertainty threatens near-term volatility and investor confidence.

item.title: Trump Renames Kennedy Center as Senator Pushes Ban on Living Politicians' Buildings
item.description: Senator John Kennedy proposes barring living politicians from having buildings named after them after Trump moves to rename the iconic Kennedy Center.

item.title: Atlantic City's Iconic Sheraton Hotel Faces December Closure Without State Rescue
item.description: The Sheraton Atlantic City Convention Center Hotel teeters on the brink of closure as its developer declares convention business alone cannot sustain operations without a state bailout or partial residential conversion.

item.title: Tesla Faces Perfect Storm: Chinese Competition, Delivery Slump, Investor Distraction
item.description: Tesla's stock is under pressure as Chinese automakers eye U.S. entry, delivery forecasts plummet, and investor attention pivots to Elon Musk's SpaceX ventures.
